name: Eyebrow
title: Eyebrow
summary: Small uppercase section labels: the `.eyebrow` in a thin blue rectangle that introduces a headline, and the quieter `.overline` that heads a list, menu or table.
whenToUse: `.eyebrow`: once above a section headline or a card title, to name the topic ("About ISM", "Statement of Faith", "Broadcast").
`.overline`: above a group of rows, a menu, a table or a form group ("Reading", "More from ISM", "All languages · 32").
The rule: eyebrow introduces a headline; overline organises a list. If there is no headline right after it, use an overline.
whenNotToUse: Do not use either as a button, a status or a tag; use Button or Badge.

props.name: children
props.description: Label text in normal case ("About ISM"); CSS uppercases it. One to three words.

react.notes: There is no Eyebrow component. In the app, the bundle's `Badge` plays this role: small uppercase, wide-tracked eyebrow label inside a thin outlined pill (see Badge). On the website, render the class:

props.name: children
props.description: One to three words ("About ISM"). Write in normal case; it is uppercased for Latin script only.

props.name: onDark
props.description: Force the on-dark colours (website `.sec-ink` sections). Defaults to the theme scheme.

variantNotes: Static labels; no hover or focus states.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: One eyebrow per section or card. Never stack two.
Eyebrow sits 16px (`--space-4`) above its headline; overline sits 8px (`--space-2`) above its list.
Keep the eyebrow square-cornered; the rounded pill is the app's Badge, not the website eyebrow.
Do not recolour eyebrows to gold, violet or status colours.
Inside dark sections, wrap in `.sec-ink` or `.on-dark` rather than overriding colours.

accessibility: An eyebrow is decorative context; the headline must make sense without it.
Write it in normal case in the HTML ("About ISM"); CSS uppercases it, so screen readers do not spell it out.
Do not use an eyebrow or overline in place of a real heading element.
content: One to three words: "About ISM", "Our mission", "Broadcast", "Updates", "Network".
Overlines name the group plainly: "Reading", "More from ISM", "All languages · 32".
